title: Presidents look into UFOs and find nothing

tellings.quote: And so every president that gets in there, you know, Clinton and Obama, Trump, you know, we're going to find out what's going on, right?

plain: Each new president, Bill Clinton, Barack Obama and Donald Trump among them, comes into office vowing to find out what is going on with UFOs, and comes away with nothing. The skeptic writer Michael Shermer says this to Michels without naming a source, as a sign that there is no hidden secret to find.
